claim_rule: A method identity never upgrades from the recorded implementation status without a new primary-source and runtime record.

methods.task: oracle-free static formula anomaly detection and ranked review
inputs: formatting and values as supported by the implementation
qct_incompatible_metrics: source-cell MRR when the implementation only emits regions
repair exactness without a shared repair oracle

runtime_record.output_contract: JSON WorkbookAnalysis with sheets, proposed fixes and foundBugs; not a complete per-formula ranking

methods.original_implementation_boundary: The legacy ExceLint repository targets Windows 10/Server, Excel 2016/365 and Visual Studio; it was not run in this Linux check.
methods.permitted_claim: official current ExceLint implementation was built and its native region/fix output can be compared where inputs are supported
methods.forbidden_claim: this run reproduces the OOPSLA experiment or proves superiority over the original paper implementation

methods.task: unsupervised spreadsheet cell clustering and formula smell detection
qct_compatible_metrics: region_hit only after an explicit cell/region mapping
qct_incompatible_metrics: source MRR without a documented mapping
methods.permitted_claim: CUSTODES establishes AST/reference-based role clustering and static outlier detection
methods.forbidden_claim: FormulaGuard has reproduced or exceeded CUSTODES without a validated implementation

methods.citation: Da Li et al., WARDER, QRS 2019, DOI 10.1109/QRS.2019.00030; journal version listed in the project literature matrix
methods.task: validity-based refinement of formula-cell clusters and defect detection
qct_compatible_metrics: region_hit or action metrics after a fixed mapping
qct_incompatible_metrics: direct source MRR without a common output contract
methods.permitted_claim: validity-based cluster refinement is established prior work
methods.forbidden_claim: FormulaGuard's role refinement is independently novel or a reproduced WARDER tool

methods.task: ambiguous-computation smell detection and constraint-based formula repair
qct_compatible_metrics: repair metrics only on a shared repair-labelled subset
qct_incompatible_metrics: silent-source ranking claims from repair accuracy
methods.permitted_claim: formula-pattern inference, cell-array ambiguity and constraint repair are established
methods.forbidden_claim: AmCheck is a directly runnable source-localization baseline in this project

methods.citation: Yang et al., Information and Software Technology 194 (2026), 108074, DOI 10.1016/j.infsof.2026.108074
qct_compatible_metrics: precision/recall/F1 on a separately defined detection task
qct_incompatible_metrics: using detection F1 as source-localization MRR
methods.permitted_claim: oracle-free perturbation and metamorphic spreadsheet detection predate this project
methods.forbidden_claim: FormulaGuard is the first spreadsheet metamorphic detector or reproduces the published SEDMR evaluation

methods.task: truth-assisted spreadsheet fault localization and debugging
qct_incompatible_metrics: unlabeled comparison to FormulaGuard's no-output contract
methods.permitted_claim: dependency-cone fault localization is an oracle-assisted reference line
methods.forbidden_claim: FormulaGuard invented spreadsheet fault localization or can be compared as an equal-input method

inputs: training/repair examples as specified by the method
qct_compatible_metrics: repair-only supplement on a shared labelled subset
methods.permitted_claim: neurosymbolic formula repair is established related work
methods.forbidden_claim: candidate repair generation is a new FormulaGuard contribution

methods.citation: FLAME: A Small Language Model for Spreadsheet Formulas, 2023
qct_compatible_metrics: repair-only supplement if a shared labelled task is fixed
methods.permitted_claim: learned formula generation is established related work
methods.forbidden_claim: a generated candidate is evidence that the source cell is erroneous

methods.task: selective classification with rejection and human handling of uncertain cases
qct_compatible_metrics: acted precision, action coverage and review cost
qct_incompatible_metrics: selective prediction as a novel FormulaGuard algorithm
